question_text: Under Art. 1 of the Constitution, India that is Bharat shall be
subject: Constitutional Law
explanation: Step 2: Detailed Explanation: Article 1(1) of the Constitution reads: "India, that is Bharat, shall be a Union of States." The Constituent Assembly deliberately chose the term "Union of States" over "Federation of States". Dr. B.R. Ambedkar explained that the term "Union" was used to signify two important things: 1. The Indian federation is not the result of an agreement among the states to join a federation. 2. The states have no right to secede from the federation. The Union is indestructible.
